label: <DEL> step of long (L>=8) sequences that start with b
explanation: Fires almost only at the delimiter step (96.5% of mass), and only when the sequence is long (L=8 or 9, essentially none for L<=7). The strongest activations are when the first original token (the one about to be output) is b: on the dev split, delimiter & L>=8 & orig(0)==b has precision 0.97 and covers 77% of activation mass. The top examples all start with b, and many start with b b. Weaker activations happen at the delimiter of long sequences starting with other tokens (j, 3, p, m, k, g; all weak), or with b as the second token. There is also small activation (3.5% of mass) on the last original token when L=9 and the sequence starts with b. Activation is higher for L=9 than L=8. Never fires during the copy phase or on short sequences.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: b, j, 3, p, k, m; least: x, 1, n, c) and the next token to output (most: b, j, a, h, g, 3; least: t, o, 2, x); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=9, to_go=8, t=8.
